Revenue growth percentages and absolute figures align logically across related sentences (S2-S3). Profitability metrics (S4-S6) show coherent progression from revenue growth to margin expansion. The tax rate change in S7 is properly contextualized with its impact on reported profit. Capital investment details in S11-S13 are presented as strategic initiatives supporting the growth narrative. Operational metrics in S14 and dividend distribution in S15 further reinforce the theme of solid performance and shareholder returns. The summary concludes (S17) by effectively synthesizing all preceding elements into a coherent overall assessment. No material contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues are present.
